plugins.name: ship-prompt
plugins.description: After each finished change, asks whether to push to main, open a PR, open a PR with auto-merge, or verify first. Stays quiet in repos with their own /ship flow.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Replaces compaction with a structured handoff, then asks before Claude carries on working.

plugins.name: agent-progress
plugins.description: A plain progress bar above the prompt for multi-step work, and a panel of subagents (/agents-panel) with model, context, estimated cost and time.
